fusions.name: Rebuking Word
fusions.desc: Speaks a word through your shield that strikes the first enemy in its path, dealing 9 damage with a 50% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Circle of Refusal
fusions.desc: Speaks a ward outward from your shield, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Spoken Ward
fusions.desc: Raises a spoken barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Rote Warding
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
